faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for Lakshadweep Administration Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date is 15 November 2026. Applications opened on 30 October 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How do I apply for Lakshadweep Administration Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Apply online through the link in the Important Links table, on or before 15 November 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the salary for Lakshadweep Administration Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It depends on the post: ₹750 per hour for Assistant Professor in English, ₹750 per hour for Assistant Professor in Economics, ₹750 per hour for Assistant Professor in Political Science, ₹750 per hour for Assistant Professor in Commerce, ₹750 per hour for Assistant Professor in Aqua Culture.

faq.question: Q4. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Masters Degree in relevant subject with minimum 55% marks and UGC NET/JRF or Ph.D / B.E/B.Tech/B.S in relevant discipline with First Class. The requirement for each post is in the eligibility table above.

faq.question: Q5. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. The engagement shall be purely on a Guest basis.

faq.question: Q6. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Shortlisting of candidates. Interview (online or in person). Essential Qualification - 75%. Desirable Qualification - 10% (Ph.D 5% Experience 5%).

faq.answer: Guest basis subject to the requirements of the Department.
